name: Urumi Yashruna
source:
A kind-hearted princess.
To save the country and people she loves, she resolves to escape the imperial castle. She expected some physical changes when she heard about the procedure for the escape, but the body remodeling far exceeds anything she imagined.
Shocked, toyed with, and gradually corrupted into lust.

Source:  [url=https://www.ordin-soft.com/kaizou_prison.html]Official Webiste[/url]
